name: Embroidery File Converter
description: A browser-only viewer and converter for PES, DST, JEF, EXP and VP3 embroidery files. Files never leave the device: the container only serves a static page. A TypeScript port of pystitch (the library Ink/Stitch uses), free and MIT licensed. Made by MavenWright, the team behind StitchKit. SHOW_CREDIT=false removes the footer link.
